_what: Invariant 10's ceiling, per frame directory: how many FEATURE NAMES each may carry outside comments, counted by splitting identifiers into words. A ratchet — these numbers may fall and may not rise. Written by reading each one, never seeded blind (B-100).
_vocabulary: The nine feature directory names, derived from the tree: account, acquisition, arrivals, library, maintenance, media, releases, settings, system
_measured: 2026-08-29, by scripts/check-frame-domain.py. An earlier pass of the same arm matched `\bword\b` and read 53 in app/ where there are 124: a domain word reaches the frame INSIDE an identifier, and a regex with word boundaries cannot see it. The mutation is what found that, not the reading.

ui._why: ZERO, and it is already true. `ui/` is the component vocabulary and names no subject; the invariant's own measurement said one word across 1 162 lines, and today it is none.

lib._why: `lib/queue.ts` carries most of it — the staging and acquisition queue, shared by two features, and invariant 7 is absolute so a queue both read had nowhere else to go. § 3 calls that « not one reviewed line » and hands the arbitration (a `domain/` bucket of its own) to a later wave. `lib/addresses.ts` and `lib/engine-drawing.ts` are exempt by the invariant itself.

app._why: The frame naming its PAGES, which is the exception the invariant blesses by name: `page-host.tsx`, `router-tree.tsx`, `reference.d.ts` and `shell.tsx` are between them the list of pages every framework has somewhere, plus `live-updates.ts`'s one import per feature (D-L10-1).
